transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you here today?

I guess… I’ve been having trouble keeping my focus at work. Like when I’m scheduling appointments or setting up the lobby displays, I’ll lose my place because I’m thinking about what I might have missed or overlooked. It’s been bothering me enough that I thought I should come in.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?
Not really, no. I mean, I get stressed and kind of worn out, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been hopeless or stopped enjoying things.
Have you been feeling more fatigued or like you’re losing energy easily lately?
I don’t know… maybe a little tired sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed losing energy in a big way.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about things or having thoughts that keep coming back, even when you don’t want them to?

Yeah… I do. I’ll tell myself, like, “Sunny, it’s handled,” but it doesn’t really stop. The thought just keeps looping, and then I’m on to the next thing I might’ve missed, kind of checking it over in my head again and again.
Do these repeating thoughts ever feel so intense or overwhelming that you have trouble functioning normally, like focusing on your job or relaxing during your downtime?

A little, yeah. I’m still getting to work and doing what I need to do, but… scheduling takes me longer because I keep double-checking myself. And sometimes with the lobby displays, I’ll lose track of what I was arranging and have to redo parts of it.

Do these thoughts ever feel uncontrollable or like they come from outside your own mind, and do you feel driven to do certain things over and over again to ease the worry, even if you know it might not make sense?

Not like it’s coming from outside my mind, no. It’s more… I know it’s me. But it can feel hard to shut off. I’ll tell myself, “Sunny, it’s handled,” and then the thought just keeps looping, and I end up going over details in my head again and again.
Do you find yourself doing certain things over and over again, either in your mind or physically, to try to reduce the worry or make sure everything is just right?
Yeah… mostly in my head. I’ll tell myself, “Sunny, it’s handled,” but it doesn’t really settle. The thought keeps looping, and then I’m checking some other detail in my mind over and over.
